decisions.statement: The release the index is built from is stated here rather than taken as the latest.
A run stages the bodies and answers a script that drafts and lands them.
A shard already there keeps the id that shard had.
Only a shard that is new is given an id.
The icons are packed into shards under a byte budget rather than into one body.
The staging folder remains after a run.
The staging folder is the first thing a refusal part way names.
A run that throws part way names every shard already whole in the stage.
A shard only half written is named nowhere, because half a shard cannot land.
Every file the answered script changes is read before that script is run.
A body rendered at or past the size a landing refuses stages nothing at all.
A shard standing that this run does not fill is named to be removed.
The single page anything outside imports reaches its shards by the path every shard sits at.
Nothing here writes under the akasha folder.
A shard that is new is written into the list the owning package's page states.

definition: the command building the icon search index from a lucide release, staged as bodies
